records.recommendation: Translate adulterated more broadly than contamination: 변질·불량 또는 허위 표시된 식품과 의약품의 주간 거래를 금지한다.

before.bodyEn: A new federal law prohibits interstate trade in adulterated or misbranded foods and medicines.

after.bodyKo: 새 연방법은 변질·불량 또는 허위 표시된 식품과 의약품의 주간 거래를 금지한다.
after.bodyEn: A new federal law prohibits interstate trade in adulterated or misbranded foods and medicines.

records.recommendation: Clarify candidate-based nonpartisan policy rather than general party endorsement.

before.bodyEn: Congressional elections took place, with the American Federation of Labor backing Democrats in support of its labor agenda.

after.bodyKo: 연방의회 선거가 실시됐다. 미국노동총연맹은 민주당 후보를 포함해 노동계 요구에 우호적인 후보들을 지원했다.
after.bodyEn: Congressional elections took place. The American Federation of Labor backed candidates sympathetic to its labor agenda, including Democrats.

records.evidence: Candidate-based wording; QN01 scholarly evidence; OUP supplemental recheck failed.

records.recommendation: Correct event date and legislative stage; synchronize team legislation stages. Senate passed July 5; final House approval July 12. NARA summary is inconsistent with congressional records.

before.bodyKo: 연방의회가 소득세 부과 권한을 명시하는 헌법 수정안을 통과시켰다. 주들의 비준이 필요하다.
before.bodyEn: Congress approved a constitutional amendment authorizing federal income taxation. Ratification by the states is required.

after.ko: 하원, 연방 소득세 수정헌법안 최종 승인
after.en: House completes congressional approval of income tax amendment
after.bodyKo: 하원이 소득세 수정헌법안을 찬성 318표, 반대 14표로 승인했다. 7월 5일 상원 통과에 이은 의회 최종 승인으로, 주들의 비준이 필요하다.
after.bodyEn: The House approved the proposed income tax amendment, 318–14, following Senate passage on July 5. State ratification is required.

records.evidence: Senate Manual and House history confirm dates and vote.

records.recommendation: Correct date and distinguish statutory hiring authorization from later appointment of Tariff Board; synchronize linked stage.

before.bodyKo: 태프트 대통령이 관세율을 개정하고 관세위원회를 설치하는 페인-올드리치 관세법에 서명했다.
before.bodyEn: President Taft signed the Payne-Aldrich tariff, revising duties and creating a Tariff Board.

after.bodyKo: 태프트 대통령이 관세율을 개정하고 관세 행정을 지원할 인력을 대통령이 채용할 수 있도록 하는 페인-올드리치 관세법에 서명했다.
after.bodyEn: President Taft signed the Payne-Aldrich tariff, revising duties and authorizing the president to hire personnel to assist in tariff administration.

records.evidence: Approval Aug 5; hiring authority distinct from later appointments.

records.recommendation: Use suspension of operations instead of wording implying permanent failure. Do not disclose reopening in 1907 news.

before.bodyKo: 예금 인출 요구가 몰리면서 뉴욕의 니커보커 신탁회사가 무너졌다. 다른 금융기관에 대한 불안도 커지고 있다.
before.bodyEn: A run brought down New York's Knickerbocker Trust Company, intensifying fears about other financial institutions.

after.bodyKo: 예금 인출 요구가 몰리면서 뉴욕의 니커보커 신탁회사가 영업을 중단했다. 다른 금융기관에 대한 불안도 커지고 있다.
after.bodyEn: A run forced New York's Knickerbocker Trust Company to suspend operations, intensifying fears about other financial institutions.

records.recommendation: Correct first chair to Anne Martin. Frame June 7 as closing day of the June 5–7 convention; exact chair election day not independently established.

before.bodyKo: 시카고 전당대회에서 전국여성당이 결성됐으며 앨리스 폴이 전국 의장으로 선출됐다.
before.bodyEn: The National Woman's Party was formed at a Chicago convention, with Alice Paul named national chair.

after.en: National Woman's Party founding convention concludes
after.bodyKo: 6월 5~7일 시카고 전당대회에서 전국여성당이 결성되고 앤 마틴이 초대 의장으로 선출됐다.
after.bodyEn: The June 5–7 Chicago convention formed the National Woman's Party and elected Anne Martin as its first chair.

records.evidence: Convention closing day; no exact election day claimed.

records.recommendation: Specify two-thirds of senators voting, not two-thirds of full membership.

before.bodyKo: 상원이 3분의 2의 찬성으로 토론을 제한할 수 있는 규칙을 채택했다. 장기 토론으로 표결이 지연되는 문제에 대응하는 조치다.
before.bodyEn: The Senate adopted a rule allowing a two-thirds majority to limit debate, addressing prolonged obstruction of votes.

after.bodyKo: 상원이 표결에 참여한 의원 3분의 2의 찬성으로 토론을 제한할 수 있는 규칙을 채택했다. 장기 토론으로 표결이 지연되는 문제에 대응하는 조치다.
after.bodyEn: The Senate adopted a rule allowing two-thirds of senators voting to limit debate, addressing prolonged obstruction of votes.

records.recommendation: Specify beverage purposes and delayed effectiveness rather than implying all alcohol uses prohibited immediately.

before.bodyKo: 연방의회가 주류의 제조·판매·운송을 금지하는 헌법 수정안을 통과시켰다. 주 비준 절차가 남아 있다.
before.bodyEn: Congress approved a constitutional amendment prohibiting the manufacture, sale and transport of intoxicating liquor. State ratification remains pending.

after.bodyKo: 연방의회가 음용 목적의 주류 제조·판매·운송을 금지하는 헌법 수정안을 통과시켰다. 주 비준 절차가 남아 있으며 비준 1년 후 효력이 발생한다.
after.bodyEn: Congress approved a constitutional amendment prohibiting the manufacture, sale and transport of intoxicating liquor for beverage purposes, to take effect one year after ratification. State ratification remains pending.

records.recommendation: Replace one-vote-short claim with actual 53–31 and failure to reach required two-thirds.

before.en: Suffrage amendment falls short in Senate

before.bodyEn: The women's suffrage amendment fell one vote short of the two-thirds majority needed in the Senate.

after.en: Suffrage amendment falls short in Senate
after.bodyKo: 상원에서 여성 참정권 수정헌법안이 찬성 53표, 반대 31표를 얻었으나 출석하여 표결한 의원의 3분의 2 요건을 충족하지 못했다.
after.bodyEn: The Senate voted 53–31 for the women's suffrage amendment, failing to reach the required two-thirds of senators present and voting.

records.recommendation: Use March 3 for last day of service or retain March 4 as transition out of office; do not treat inclusive service date and transition as necessarily contradictory.

after.bodyKo: 노스캐롤라이나주 흑인 하원의원 조지 화이트의 임기가 종료됐다.
after.bodyEn: The congressional term of North Carolina's Black representative George H. White ended.

records.evidence: Retain March 4 transition out of office, distinct from March 3 last recorded service day.

records.recommendation: For exact-day precision describe opening of founding convention; avoid asserting formal organization completed on opening day.

before.en: Industrial Workers of the World formed
before.bodyKo: 시카고에서 세계산업노동자연맹이 결성됐다. 기존 미국노동총연맹과 다른 노동 조직화 노선을 추구한다.

after.bodyEn: The founding convention of the Industrial Workers of the World opened in Chicago, seeking a different approach to labor organizing from the American Federation of Labor.

before.bodyKo: 러시아와 일본이 뉴햄프셔주 포츠머스에서 평화조약에 서명했다. 조약은 한국에 대한 일본의 우월한 이해관계를 인정한다.
before.bodyEn: Russia and Japan signed a peace treaty at Portsmouth, New Hampshire, recognizing Japan's predominant interests in Korea.

after.bodyKo: 러시아와 일본이 포츠머스 해군조선소에서 평화조약에 서명했다. 조약은 한국에 대한 일본의 우월한 이해관계를 인정한다.
after.bodyEn: Russia and Japan signed a peace treaty at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, recognizing Japan's predominant interests in Korea.

records.evidence: Building 86 at shipyard; present-day Kittery, Maine; avoid retrospective jurisdiction.

after.bodyKo: 올드리치-브릴랜드법이 제정됐다. 비상시 통화 발행을 허용하고 국가통화위원회를 설치한다.

after.bodyEn: Senator John W. Kern was elected chair of the Senate Democratic Conference, taking on a functional floor leadership role.

records.evidence: Formal conference chair vs functional leader.

records.recommendation: Specify further authorization rather than first approval; AOC corroborates project and earlier authorization, not exact April 28 date.

after.bodyEn: Congress granted further authorization for construction of a fire-resistant Senate office building.

after.bodyKo: 조지 체임벌린 상원의원과 프랭크 몬델 하원의원이 연방 여성 참정권 수정안을 제출했다.
after.bodyEn: Senator George Chamberlain and Representative Frank Mondell introduced proposals for federal woman suffrage.

records.recommendation: Replace ambiguous referral terminology with favorable report to full House.

after.bodyEn: The House Judiciary Committee reported the Bristow-Mondell suffrage measure favorably.

records.recommendation: Distinguish formal acceptance of donated statue from approval of installation.

after.bodyEn: Congress accepted Frances Willard's statue, the first depicting a woman in Statuary Hall.

records.recommendation: Specify loss in general election after losing Republican nomination, avoiding inference that she was Republican Senate nominee.

before.bodyEn: Jeannette Rankin, the first woman in the House, lost her Montana Senate race.

after.ko: 대법원, 오리건 여성 노동시간 규제 인정

records.recommendation: Korean 출신 may imply former governor; identify him as New York governor and distinguish confirmation from later oath.

before.bodyEn: The Senate confirmed New York Governor Charles Evans Hughes as associate justice.

after.bodyKo: 상원이 현직 뉴욕주지사 찰스 에번스 휴스의 연방대법관 지명을 인준했다.
after.bodyEn: The Senate confirmed New York Governor Charles Evans Hughes as associate justice.

records.recommendation: Clarify legal criterion rather than suggest general restriction on all immigrants.

before.bodyKo: 하이럼 존슨 주지사가 일본인 이민자 등의 토지 소유를 제한하는 법에 서명했다.
before.bodyEn: Governor Hiram Johnson signed legislation restricting land ownership by immigrants including Japanese nationals.

after.bodyKo: 하이럼 존슨 주지사가 일본인 등 귀화 자격이 없는 외국인의 토지 권리를 조약상 권리를 제외하고 제한하는 법에 서명했다.

records.recommendation: Keep October 1 as invitation date, change English title/body that imply meeting already held. Alternatively use October 3 for meeting event. Avoid future information.

before.bodyKo: 루스벨트 대통령이 노동조합 지도자와 탄광 경영진을 백악관으로 초청했다.
before.bodyEn: Roosevelt convened union leaders and mine operators at the White House.

after.ko: 루스벨트, 탄광 파업 당사자 회담 초청

after.bodyKo: 루스벨트 대통령이 노동조합 지도자와 탄광 경영진을 백악관으로 초청했다.

after.bodyEn: The commission opposed discrimination against workers for union membership.

records.recommendation: Roosevelt had already been president since 1901; use began elected term or sworn in for full term.
